correctness.rationale: The q distinct singleton letters force >=q attractor positions. All minimal candidates choose one occurrence per residue j modulo q. For factors of length <q, nonwrap terminal letter and boundary-crossing q−1 marker suffice unless critical factor F_r is missed; for longer factors the union of successive q-spaced occurrence intervals is contiguous and missing forces t_{q−1}=m−1, t_r=0, t_j∈{0,m} for j<r. Exactly those choices miss F_r, giving complete characterization and counting formula across m=1 and r=q−1 boundaries. Independently enumerated factor-occurrence coverage for small q,m, not substituted for unrestricted proof.
